A shelf of herbs in one bottle

The back label names six main ingredients and 94 more rare herbs. These are the ones you will recognise.

Amla

Indian gooseberry, a staple of traditional hair oils.

Bhringraj

Known in Ayurveda as the herb for hair care.

Reetha

Soapnut, used for generations in hair care.

Sikakai

A classic pod used in traditional hair washes and oils.

Zaitoon oil

Olive oil that carries the herbs and glides through hair.

Almond oil

A light, vitamin E rich oil that leaves hair soft.

Three steps, a few times a week

Directions are taken from the bottle label.

1

Apply

Apply the oil 3 to 4 times a week, parting the hair so it reaches the scalp.

2

Massage and wait

Massage into the roots with your fingertips and leave it on for 6 hours.

3

Wash

Wash out with your normal shampoo.

Questions

How do I order?

Add the oil to your cart, enter your name, phone number, address and quantity, then confirm. WhatsApp opens with your order ready to send to us.

What does it cost?

Each 150 ml bottle is Rs 2,000. Delivery is Rs 250 per order.

How do I pay?

We confirm your order and the payment details with you on WhatsApp before dispatch.

How often should I use it?

The label says to apply it 3 to 4 times a week, massage it into the roots, leave it for 6 hours and wash with normal shampoo.

Is it safe for my skin?

It is for external use only. Do a small patch test before first use, and stop if you notice irritation. If you have a scalp condition or heavy hair loss, see a doctor.
